locations: Online written examination and coding test: problem composition
source_reads.finding: Both divisions cover sections 1–4. Written: 180 minutes, 80 multiple-choice and 10 written responses. Coding: 180 minutes, two tasks.
source_reads.limitation: Exam composition does not specify course workload, age-based prerequisites, or permitted software for a particular future sitting.
source_reads.locator: Middle-school division; Online written examination and coding test: problem composition

source_reads.finding: The page distinguishes principles from actual appropriate library use, data application and output interpretation; 60 grouped rows carry separate theory/practical flags.
source_reads.limitation: The displayed syllabus version differs from the governing competition year. Example names and the plan's expanded obligations must remain distinguishable.
source_reads.locator: Topic classification; Sections 1–4 and both preprocessing footnotes

source_reads.version: Full-scope recalibration; SHA256 pinned in contract.json
source_reads.finding: The later recalibration retains 120-minute classes, schedules all 60 rows with required outside work and separates optional extensions.
source_reads.limitation: A schedule is not an execution or mastery record. Prior numeric diagnostic targets and time estimates are not scientifically calibrated thresholds.
source_reads.locator: Ten week rows; scope-01 through scope-60; Time and starting-preparation rows

source_reads.finding: The paper operationalizes intended performances and aligns activities and assessment; its teacher-development example distinguishes naming information from applying and relating it.
source_reads.limitation: A conceptual framework and illustrated teacher-development setting do not establish a randomized KOAI effect; activity choice still needs situated judgment and local testing.

source_reads.finding: The authors report different effects of example study and generation by element interactivity and prior knowledge.
source_reads.limitation: This reading obtained the author-repository abstract; do not cite unseen methods or use its results to set local numeric diagnostic cutoffs.

source_reads.finding: Undergraduates studied science texts with matched initial time; retrieval was compared with elaborative concept mapping and evaluated after a week, including inference questions.
source_reads.limitation: Science-text learning in that sample does not validate a programming diagnostic, a 10-minute local exercise or 30-minute agent cadence.

source_reads.finding: The arithmetic mean is computed over the selected axes; default reduction flattens the input, and keepdims changes retained dimensions.
source_reads.limitation: The built-in reference check below covers rectangular finite two-dimensional inputs with axis 0 or 1 and keepdims false.

source_reads.finding: Preprocessing is learned on training data. Validation can select settings; final test information must not select them.
source_reads.limitation: Disjoint row IDs alone do not exclude group, temporal or target leakage. The declared split audit cannot prove absence of all contamination.
source_reads.locator: 12.2 Data leakage; 12.2.1 How to avoid data leakage

source_reads.finding: Binary precision uses TP/(TP+FP); an absent predicted-positive denominator requires an explicit undefined-value convention.
source_reads.limitation: Different averaging and positive-label conventions require a separate specification; the reference check is binary counts only.

source_reads.finding: The study distinguishes intrinsic revision from external feedback and identifies inference-budget and prompt confounds.
source_reads.limitation: Its older models and reasoning tasks do not establish a permanent inability of later models or outcomes for lesson production.
source_reads.locator: Experimental setup and results; Prompt design issues; Limitations

source_reads.finding: The work evaluates citation quality separately from other answer properties.
source_reads.limitation: The paper is a rationale for checking actual support, not evidence that recording a URL authenticates a claim.

source_reads.finding: The benchmark explicitly includes updated information, temporal reasoning and abstention; preserving original evidence and retrieval keys can matter.
source_reads.limitation: Conversational memory experiments do not prove that this local dependency graph or deduplication policy is complete.
source_reads.locator: Benchmark task categories; Memory indexing and retrieval experiments

source_reads.finding: Representation format, domain interpretation and translation impose learning demands. This conceptual synthesis supports reviewing the purpose and correspondence of formulas, plots and diagrams.
source_reads.limitation: It does not validate these local T-checks. Adding representations can increase the demands on novices; more visuals are not automatically better.

source_reads.version: Sentance, Waite and Kallia (2019), author preprint, 34 PDF pages
source_reads.finding: The non-randomized school study compared a bundled reading/prediction/discussion approach with usual instruction. It motivates explicit explanation and tracing.
source_reads.limitation: Schools and teachers were not randomly assigned; some controls were unavailable, and teachers reported excessive volume/difficult questions. It does not isolate our pseudocode gate or establish a KOAI effect.

Mean and variance symbols, finite same-unit values, n>=1, indices, units and empty-domain exclusion are stated. Generic a_ij, m, p, c_j and r_i definitions/ranges appear with formula. Rectangular 2D, keepdims=False, mathematical 1-based versus Python 0-based indexing, and output shapes are explicit. n versus n-1 convention and ddof are distinguished.

Equal-share equation derives mean from sum preservation. Sum of deviations is derived as sum(x)-n*mean=0. Variance is correctly identified as a definition, not uniquely forced by cancellation; repeated-data example motivates normalization. Worked 8/3 cm2 and zero spread agree. Generic column/row denominator follows actual summand count. Wrong denominator counterexample 18/2=9 exposes error. Translation invariance is explained by cancelling equal shifts.

Variance figure pixels directly inspected: common cm x-scale, ordered-record y-label, vertical mean=4 line, signed arrows -2/0/+2 and square labels 4/0/4 map consistently to formula and caption. Axis attachment pixels inspected in baseline; candidate attachment equality verified. Axis diagram groups, averages, remaining counts and arrows match text. Interpretation prompts ask mapping marks back to inputs and formula; feedback supplies reasoning.

Mean state trace, finite-loop stopping and empty error correspond to implementation. Column-mean pseudocode resets each column total; explicit traces 0->2->8->18 and 0->4->12->24 yield [6,8]. Positive rectangular dimensions exclude empty axes. Mapping to NumPy reductions and retained dimensions is explicit. Independent pinned quality oracle matched A/B both axes and singleton, rejecting empty/ragged cases; independent actual NumPy results match.

Predict-before-run hand tasks, 4x3 changed-shape questions, shifted-value variance probe and new B assessment require explanation of denominator and shape. Teacher B key checked: columns [2,6,10] /2, rows [5,7] /3, first row variance 32/3 cm2. Support returns to circling inputs making one output; feedback addresses sum-as-mean and bigger-value-as-bigger-variance misconceptions. Actual learning not inferred.
